notes.title: Version 0.6
notes.notes:
There's a new update out!

Here's a changelog:

Features

Replaced old skeletons with cool new robots
You can dismember enemies
New level, very challenging has four spawn points
New Spear Tower, shoots spears in all directions
The total amount text in level celebration is now less confusing because it shows you how many you gained
Buffed Shotgun upgrade


Fixes

Fixed bug with the way level celebration music fades in
You can no longer build while "You Won" text is visible.
Mineral groups no longer look exactly the same
Fixed bug where selection screens were not very responsive
Path line is no longer visible if the spawner is not active yet


Here's some gameplay footage from the new update, featuring level 4:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=80NGT68QFB8
